title: Leaves Grease Spots
text: Leaves Grease Spots. The wax on this bag left permanent grease-like spots on clothing placed inside.  Too bad, it’s otherwise a cool bag.

product_metadata.title: ZENPAC Waxed Canvas Bag - Large Trendy Grocery Tote with Handles, Reusable Shopping Bag Made of Durable Vintage Cotton Fabric
features: ● ENVIRONMENTALLY FRIENDLY: 100% eco-friendly and made from waxed canvas and kraft papers. These bags are reusable and can be easily cleaned. Bags fold flat for easy storage in the car or home.

● BUILT TO LAST: Our everyday wax canvas kraft shopping bags are made with heavy duty washable material and double-stitched at the seams for a longer lifespan. The waxed canvas will not be discolored by the sunlight and can be used indoors or out.
● VERSATILE: More than just a grocery bag, these bags can be used as a lunch bag, outdoor bag, backpack, or even a gift bag. Fashioned with comfortable, long handles allowing for easy carry.

● EASY TO CLEAN: The waxed canvas kraft fabric repels water and dirt. Made from all-natural materials, these bags can withstand the elements, and do not stain easily. To clean wipe dirt away with a damp cloth or sponge and let dry.

● SPACIOUS INTERIOR: The spacious interior gives you enough room to carry all your belongings in one trip with a carrying capacity of up to 60lbs. Measuring at 12” w X 17.5”h X 6” d. Bags have a faded olive green color.
